nodes.name: sync_debug.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for debugging in-flight OAuth/redirect sync flows, exposing pending-flow state inspection and manual cleanup to the frontend.

nodes.name: sync_import.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for project sync import operations: listing/retrying/discarding import problems and listing/resolving/dismissing sync conflicts.

nodes.name: sync_oauth.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers implementing the OAuth authorization flow for creating and reconnecting sync connections, including pending-flow tracking and provider token exchange.

nodes.name: sync_webhook.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for installing, checking status of, and rotating secrets for project sync webhooks.

nodes.name: work_items.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers exposing work item read/write/delete/move/batch CRUD operations (project-scoped and standalone) to the frontend.

nodes.name: events.rs
nodes.summary: Lightweight observer registry that lets other modules register a data-changed notifier callback and broadcast change notifications to the frontend.

nodes.name: assets.rs
nodes.summary: File-based storage layer for project asset uploads: saving, deleting, listing, and resolving on-disk paths with filename validation against traversal.

nodes.name: debug_peek_connection_redirect_flow
nodes.summary: Tauri command that inspects a connection's pending OAuth redirect-flow state for debugging, without mutating it.

nodes.name: debug_drop_connection_pending
nodes.summary: Tauri command that force-clears a connection's pending OAuth flow entry for debugging stuck flows.

nodes.name: project_sync_list_problems
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing sync import problems recorded for a project.

nodes.name: project_sync_retry_entry
nodes.summary: Tauri command that retries a single failed sync import entry by id.

nodes.name: project_sync_discard_entry
nodes.summary: Tauri command that discards a failed sync import entry without retrying.

nodes.name: project_sync_import_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the current import status for a project's sync adapter.

nodes.name: project_sync_import_cancel
nodes.summary: Tauri command that cancels an in-progress sync import for a project's adapter.

nodes.name: project_sync_import_retry
nodes.summary: Tauri command that restarts a previously failed or cancelled sync import for an adapter.

nodes.name: project_sync_conflicts_list
nodes.summary: Tauri command listing unresolved sync conflicts for a project.

nodes.name: project_sync_conflicts_count
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the count of unresolved sync conflicts for a project.

nodes.name: project_sync_conflict_use_local
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resolves a sync conflict by keeping the local version and discarding the remote change.

nodes.name: project_sync_conflict_use_remote
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resolves a sync conflict by accepting the remote version, overwriting the local change.

nodes.name: project_sync_conflict_dismiss
nodes.summary: Tauri command that dismisses a sync conflict record without applying either side.

nodes.name: test_skip_browser
nodes.summary: Test-only Tauri command toggling a flag that skips opening a real browser during OAuth flow tests.

nodes.name: sync_connection_oauth_start
nodes.summary: Tauri command that begins an OAuth authorization flow for a new sync connection, returning the authorize URL and tracking the pending flow.

nodes.name: sync_connection_oauth_complete
nodes.summary: Tauri command that completes a pending OAuth flow for a connection by exchanging the received code for tokens.

nodes.name: sync_connection_oauth_cancel
nodes.summary: Tauri command that cancels an in-progress OAuth authorization flow for a connection.

nodes.name: start_oauth_flow_inner
nodes.summary: Internal helper that starts an OAuth flow (new connection or reconnect) with a given scope and adapter, registering pending-flow tracking and cancel token.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: From-trait conversion mapping an internal pending-flow entry into the public API response type.

nodes.name: complete_oauth_flow_for_adapter
nodes.summary: Performs provider-specific OAuth token exchange for the given adapter using the flow snapshot, producing connection credentials.

nodes.name: drop_connection_pending
nodes.summary: Clears a connection's pending OAuth flow entry from in-memory tracking state.

nodes.name: project_sync_webhook_install
nodes.summary: Tauri command that installs a webhook with the remote provider for a project's sync adapter.

nodes.name: project_sync_webhook_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reports the current webhook installation status for a project's sync adapter.

nodes.name: project_sync_webhook_rotate
nodes.summary: Tauri command that rotates the signing secret of an installed webhook for a project's sync adapter.

nodes.name: project_read_work_items
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading all work items for a project.

nodes.name: project_read_work_items_enriched
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading all work items for a project with resolved label/member/project display data.

nodes.name: project_read_work_items_view_data
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading a filtered/searchable view of project work items for list rendering.

nodes.name: project_read_work_item
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading a single work item by short id within a project.

nodes.name: work_item_read_standalone_items
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading all standalone (non-project) work items for an organization.

nodes.name: work_item_read_standalone_item
nodes.summary: Tauri command reading a single standalone work item by short id.

nodes.name: project_write_work_item
nodes.summary: Tauri command writing/creating a work item's frontmatter and body within a project.

nodes.name: work_item_write_standalone_item
nodes.summary: Tauri command writing/creating a standalone work item's frontmatter and body.

nodes.name: project_delete_work_item
nodes.summary: Tauri command soft-deleting a work item within a project.

nodes.name: project_restore_work_item
nodes.summary: Tauri command restoring a previously soft-deleted work item.

nodes.name: project_purge_expired_deleted_work_items
nodes.summary: Tauri command permanently purging work items whose soft-delete retention window has expired.

nodes.name: project_update_work_item_partial
nodes.summary: Tauri command applying a partial field update to a work item.

nodes.name: project_move_work_item
nodes.summary: Tauri command moving a work item from one project to another.

nodes.name: project_allocate_work_item_id
nodes.summary: Tauri command allocating the next unique short id for a new work item in a project.

nodes.name: work_item_allocate_standalone_id
nodes.summary: Tauri command allocating the next unique short id for a new standalone work item.

nodes.name: project_batch_delete_work_items
nodes.summary: Tauri command batch-deleting multiple work items in a project.

nodes.name: project_batch_update_work_items
nodes.summary: Tauri command batch-applying a partial update to multiple work items in a project.

nodes.name: register_data_changed_notifier
nodes.summary: Registers a callback to be invoked whenever project/work-item data changes, used to push updates to the frontend.

nodes.name: notify_data_changed
nodes.summary: Invokes the registered data-changed notifier, if any, to signal listeners that data has changed.

nodes.name: save_asset
nodes.summary: Writes uploaded asset bytes to disk under the project's assets directory after filename validation.

nodes.name: delete_asset
nodes.summary: Removes an asset file from a project's assets directory.

nodes.name: list_assets
nodes.summary: Lists asset files stored under a project's assets directory.

nodes.name: resolve_asset_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk path for a project asset by filename, validating it stays within the assets root.

nodes.name: validate_asset_filename
nodes.summary: Validates an asset filename to reject path traversal and unsafe characters.
